channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Rita M. Kester
item.description: Rita M. Kester, 89, of Austin, Minnesota, passed away on Sunday, February 8, 2026, at Generations Child and Memory Care in Mankato, Minnesota.

item.title: Twins starting pitcher David Festa expected to start season on injured list
item.description: Twins' rotation takes another hit as David Festa faces early-season IL stint with new shoulder issue, while Pablo López's elbow surgery offers optimism and Joe Ryan targets Opening Day.

item.title: MacPhail Austin announces transition to independent non-profit: Austin Community Music Center
item.description: After more than 11 years in Austin, MacPhail's local program will spin off into a community-led non-profit

item.title: Pacelli's oldest living alumnus passes away at age of 101
item.description: Pacelli Catholic Schools mourns 101-year-old alumna Margaret Overlie, last surviving member of the Class of 1942, remembered for her strong Catholic faith and lifelong love of learning.

item.title: Three area wrestlers advance to state quarterfinals
item.description: Three area wrestlers reach Class A state quarterfinals at Grand Casino Arena, while nine teammates drop into wrestlebacks after opening-round losses.

item.title: Superlarks advance to quarterfinals for first time in five years
item.description: No. 6 Grand Meadow rode a 16-2 first-half surge and Logan Grafe’s 20 points to top Lyle-Pacelli 60-49, earning its first section quarterfinal trip in five years.

item.title: Koenigs leads Rebel boys past Cardinals in playoff opener
item.description: Freshman Brekken Koenigs hits six threes as No. 1 Southland routs LeRoy-Ostrander 91-40 in the Section 1A opener, setting up a quarterfinal vs. Faribault Bethlehem Academy on Monday.

item.title: Hayfield boys basketball team moves past Fillmore Central
item.description: Hayfield boys basketball outlasts Fillmore Central 80-70 in a Section 1A opener, advancing to face Mabel-Canton Monday at Mayo Civic Center.

item.title: Blue Devil men open playoffs with a win
item.description: Riverland CC men's basketball beat Mesabi Range 108-56 in the Region Tournament opener, led by 24 bench points from Lubab Kambalo; Blue Devils now 27-2.

item.title: Packer boys bring down Rockets
item.description: Xzaveun Severin's 31 points power Austin to 68-53 win over Rochester John Marshall; Cole Hebrink adds 25.
